_comment: Photo credits, keyed by slug. `place` must match a Name in data/*.csv exactly — tools/import-places.py matches on it and will fail loudly if it doesn't. Licence and author are not optional metadata: the CC BY and CC BY-SA images may only be published with the author credited, so the app renders `author`, `license` and `source` under every photo. Public-domain images need no credit but are shown the same way.
